name: Wizard
ability: Once per game, choose to make a wish. If granted, it might have a price & leave a clue as to its nature.
designRole: One wish whose effects are adjudicated by the Storyteller; this app does not invent wishes or their effects.
explanation: One wish whose effects are adjudicated by the Storyteller; this app does not invent wishes or their effects.

nightInstructions.firstNight: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Wizard's ability.
nightInstructions.otherNights: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Wizard's ability.

storytellerNotes: The app does not invent a wish or its consequences. Storyteller adjudication is required.

sources.title: The Pandemonium Institute: released character data

sources.description: Initial editable editorial annotations in data/design/botc-annotations.json. Numeric signals and synergy judgements are not official ratings.

generationRestriction: Reference and imported scripts supported. Automated generation excludes this role because it needs bespoke Storyteller adjudication or a nonstandard no-evil script.
